title: Possible Bipartition
summary: Determine if it's possible to divide n people into two groups such that no one dislikes someone in their own group, given a list of dislikes.
statement: Determine if it's possible to divide n people into two groups such that no one dislikes someone in their own group, given a list of dislikes.
constraints: People are labeled 1..n and dislike edges are undirected.
Return whether people can be split so every dislike edge crosses groups.
hints: The requested split is exactly a two-coloring of the dislike graph.
Color every connected component by BFS or DFS.
Assign each unseen neighbor the opposite color; reject an equal-colored edge.
A proper two-coloring gives the two groups, and any odd-cycle conflict proves no split exists.
editorial: A proper two-coloring gives the two groups, and any odd-cycle conflict proves no split exists.
